name.description: The app's name: its binary, and with the stack, its unit, user and paths

repo.description: The repository that builds the binary, such as github.com/org/repo

domain.description: The DNS zone every host name of the app is in

edge.description: What is in front of the app's host names: cloudflare, or empty for none

secretPrefix.description: The app's secrets in the parameter store, with {stack} for the stack, such as /example/{stack}/app/

stateDirectory.description: Whether the app keeps state on local disk and gets a private state directory

selfcheck.description: Whether a deploy runs the app's selfcheck subcommand before and after the switch

logFiles.description: Files the app writes under /var/log/<unit>/, rotated daily by rename and kept a week

stacks.description: The app's deployments by stack name, such as prod and staging

notes.description: Why the app is set up this way; JSON has no comments

appRole.description: Whether the app runs as a separate role with rows only, rather than as the owner

ownerDsn.description: Parameter under the secret prefix holding the owner role's connection string, such as migrate/APP_PG_ADMIN_DSN

appDsn.description: Parameter under the secret prefix holding the app role's connection string; required with appRole

appPassword.description: Parameter under the secret prefix holding the app role's password alone, for a migration that sets it

endpoint.description: The server's host name; give it or endpointFrom

endpointFrom.description: Where to read the server's host name, such as a Pulumi stack output

adminDatabase.description: The database the administrator connects to

adminPassword.description: Where the administrator's password is kept

via.description: The fleet host that runs psql against the server

lockdown.description: The server's other databases, which no app's role may reach

reachable.description: Databases the provider owns whose CONNECT cannot be revoked, such as template1

lightsailName.description: The server's name as a Lightsail relational database, for snapshots before a deploy

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows, for editors

formatVersion.description: Version of the fleet document format the file follows

primaryStack.description: The stack whose unit, user and paths are named for the app alone; prod when empty

portRange.description: The range apps' loopback ports come from

acmeEmail.description: The address Caddy registers with for certificates it gets itself, for apps with no edge

databaseServer.description: The PostgreSQL server the apps' databases are on, when deployforge provisions their roles

name.description: How stacks refer to the host

address.description: The host's address for SSH; give it or addressFrom

addressFrom.description: Where to read the host's address when it is used, such as a Pulumi stack output

sshUser.description: The user to connect as over SSH, with sudo; ubuntu when empty

connectionLimit.description: Each database role's CONNECTION LIMIT, which the app's pools should match

key.description: The configuration key, such as fleet:dbMasterPassword

output.description: The output holding the address, such as staticIp

parameter.description: A parameter's full name in the parameter store

pulumiConfig.description: A Pulumi stack's secret configuration value

host.description: The host the stack runs on, by name

hosts.description: Host names the reverse proxy forwards to the stack

loopbackHosts.description: Host names among hosts that the host resolves to itself, so the app's calls to them stay on the host

port.description: The loopback port the binary listens on

databases.description: The stack's databases on the database server; each name unique across the fleet

limits.description: Resource limits; required once the stack is live

title: Fleet
description: The hosts, the apps deployforge deploys to them, and each app's stacks.
